question: Should Track A ship with the default 10-minute zero-activity visible-turn takeover before phase-aware Track B liveness is implemented?
rationale: The patch targets severe stuck-lane bugs, but the takeover intentionally changes upgrade behavior and can cancel quiet-but-alive work; that policy tradeoff cannot be decided mechanically even after the narrow stamp defect is repaired.

options.title: Accept Track A after stamp repair
options.body: Keep the 10-minute takeover, require the queued CLI reasoning activity fix, and track phase-aware false-positive reduction under the canonical run-lifecycle issue.

options.title: Narrow takeover before merge
options.body: Ship terminal-unreleased force-clear now and defer no-activity takeover until stronger activity evidence exists.

options.title: Require Track B first
options.body: Hold this PR until phase-aware liveness can distinguish silent-but-alive tool phases from dead runs.

recommendation.title: Accept Track A after stamp repair
recommendation.body: Keep the 10-minute takeover, require the queued CLI reasoning activity fix, and track phase-aware false-positive reduction under the canonical run-lifecycle issue.
